resolution_policy: Install only after preflight. Verify source revision, artifact SHA-256, license, and runtime compatibility before activation.

dependencies.name: ComfyUI
dependencies.install_method: git clone followed by git checkout 2a610155821d670a2d8047e654e5fce96b790eb5
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Official Krea 2 support commit is pinned; runtime import/load and workflow execution tests remain required. Git trees do not have one artifact SHA in this lock.

dependencies.name: comfyui-krea2edit
dependencies.purpose: Krea 2 identity edit model patch and grounded encode nodes
dependencies.install_method: clone to ComfyUI/custom_nodes and checkout the pinned commit
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Live node signature must be inspected at this commit before model installation.

dependencies.name: ComfyUI-Manager
dependencies.purpose: current supported ComfyUI dependency manager, enabled only after registry and security review
dependencies.install_method: clone the exact revision into ComfyUI/custom_nodes
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Manager registry snapshot and security configuration remain unverified; bootstrap must not enable it until that gate passes.

dependencies.name: jsonschema
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Pure Python package; selected wheel/source hash must match the lock.

dependencies.name: setuptools
dependencies.purpose: build backend for the standalone project
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Build-system dependency is pinned separately from runtime ComfyUI dependencies.

dependencies.name: Pillow
dependencies.purpose: optional image decode/crop and uncompressed DDS pixel oracle
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Apple Silicon CPython 3.12 wheel plus source distribution are pinned; current system Python 3.9 cannot satisfy the project runtime floor.

dependencies.name: hoi4-portrait-project-nodes
dependencies.purpose: fail-closed preprocessing, evidence, prompt, and contract nodes
dependencies.install_method: copy or symlink the checked-out project node package into ComfyUI/custom_nodes
dependencies.compatibility_notes: Source checksum is recorded in the release manifest after each bounded commit.
